title: Infant gut anellovirus composition associates with early life factors and childhood atopic disease
core_idea: Profile the faecal viromes of 647 one-year-old children to catalogue anellovirus species diversity and evaluate how early-life environmental exposures (e.g., daycare attendance, older siblings), host genetic factors (FUT2 secretor status), and microbial community components relate to anellovirus composition and subsequent childhood atopic outcomes.
tldr: Cohort-based virome profiling of one-year-old infants aiming to map anellovirus diversity and examine relationships with early-life exposures, host genetics, microbiome context, and later atopic disease risk.
